suggestion: Implement deterministic traversal from rootLabels and childLabels with visited-set semantics
rationale: Required to derive canonical keys from nodesByLabel DAG reliably

suggestion: Use keyGeneration delimiter and from policy as the only key build mechanism
rationale: Prevents drift between schema intent and generated keys

suggestion: Resolve generatorCapabilities[*].keySchema against keySchemaRegistry before generation
rationale: Ensures capability runs with an explicit versioned schema

suggestion: Compile metaArgsValidation command and apply it to entry metaArgs when scopeFilter is present
rationale: Enables restrictive generation scope without hardcoding logic

suggestion: Validate config-key.cue sections against config-key.schema.cue before generation
rationale: Fails early on malformed input shape

suggestion: Compare derived expected keys by kind with config-key.cue keys and report missing and unexpected keys
rationale: Captures schema/data divergence early

suggestion: Validate command sections in validations against supportedCommandSections
rationale: Keeps command namespaces controlled across versions

suggestion: Select generators by target and supportsNodeKinds and keep unknown target as hard error
rationale: Prevents silent no-op or wrong output mapping

suggestion: Introduce new keySchemaRegistry id when semantics change and keep older ids immutable
rationale: Supports safe evolution and backward compatibility

suggestion: Emit diagnostics with stable IDs for schema, config, and generation stages
rationale: Improves automation and troubleshooting reliability

suggestion: Adopt camelCase for ARB keys and generated Dart API compatibility
rationale: Aligns with Flutter AppLocalizations naming conventions

suggestion: Use a stable feature prefix for every key (for example auth, checkout, settings)
rationale: Improves searchability and avoids cross-feature key collisions

suggestion: Prefer semantic intent suffixes such as Title Label Button Error DialogBody
rationale: Clarifies UI role without encoding fragile layout position

suggestion: Ban generic shared keys like saveButton in favor of feature-scoped keys
rationale: Reduces ambiguity and accidental reuse across unrelated contexts

suggestion: Treat key renames as schema migrations and preserve stability across copy tweaks
rationale: Keys should survive wording and minor UI updates

suggestion: Avoid strict positional naming templates; keep structure loose but consistent
rationale: Prevents artificial verbose keys and supports real-world complexity

suggestion: Store strict structural metadata outside the key string (ARB metadata or external config)
rationale: Keeps keys readable while preserving machine-usable structure

suggestion: Add a naming lint check that enforces prefix and generic-key denylist rules
rationale: Automates consistency and prevents regressions

suggestion: Publish supported CLI commands in registry metadata and fail unknown command invocation
rationale: Makes CLI capabilities explicit and versioned with the spec

suggestion: Fail lint when validation command sections are outside supportedCommandSections
rationale: Converts section governance from convention into an enforceable rule

suggestion: Validate artifactPattern placeholders against an allowed token set and required-by-target policy
rationale: Prevents invalid output path templates and target-specific omissions

suggestion: Raise errors for graph cycles and generated key collisions during key derivation
rationale: Ensures deterministic key generation from nodesByLabel

suggestion: Require each i18n entry to provide all supportedLanguages when translationPolicy demands it
rationale: Keeps localized output complete and consistent
